title: Integrate ACE-Step LoRA and DoRA-row training across GPU backends
design: Port the SA3 GGML training patch stack onto ACE-Step's newer GGML pin. Route every ACE-Step DiT linear projection through an optional functional adapter transform. Apply LoRA and DoRA-row normalization without materializing effective weights; support fused-weight views.
acceptance_criteria: CPU forward/backward numerical gradient test passes. CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal execute the training graph with quantized frozen weights. Trainer saves/resumes and emits PEFT-compatible adapter artifacts. Tiny real dataset slice overfits and reloads into inference. Unadapted inference remains unchanged.
notes: Imported the full MIT ACE-Step source history at the Sawhee root. Current sa3.cpp pins public GGML ba817aa on v0.16.0; Sawhee pins the tested ACE-base rebase 7ccc6df. The rebased GGML history will be published as ggml/acestep-training in twilwa/sawhee so recursive clones remain reproducible without a second repository. CPU, Metal, Vulkan, and quantized DoRA graph evidence remains green; CUDA hardware and official-GGUF training remain.
